title: SINFOS: A Parallel Dataset for Translating Sinhala Figures of Speech
reasoning: The paper categorizes and benchmarks Sinhala figures of speech based on cultural themes including 'Ethics & Moral Character' and 'Karma & Consequence.' It specifically evaluates LLM performance on translating 'Apthopadesha' (proverbs containing moral lessons or advice) and 'Karma' related imagery, which are deeply rooted in religious and ethical traditions.
